title: Tensor product of complexes of modules on a ringed site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. For cochain complexes $\mathcal F^\bullet$, $\mathcal G^\bullet$ of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules, the double complex $\mathcal F^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal G^\bullet$ has terms $\mathcal F^p\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal G^q$ (the tensor product of sheaves of modules [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]), first differential $d_{\mathcal F}\otimes 1$ and second differential $1\otimes d_{\mathcal G}$. Its total complex $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal F^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal G^\bullet)$ is the complex with terms $\bigoplus_{p+q=n}\mathcal F^p\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal G^q$ (a direct sum in the abelian category of $\mathcal O$-modules, which has all direct sums) and differential $\sum_{p+q=n}(d_{\mathcal F}^p\otimes 1+(-1)^p\,1\otimes d_{\mathcal G}^q)$. It is written $\mathcal F^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal G^\bullet$ when no confusion arises; it is functorial in both complexes.
